drug_class: Sulfonamide antibiotic with dihydrofolate reductase inhibitor

avoid_supplements.name: Methotrexate
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Both drugs inhibit dihydrofolate reductase; combined effect increases toxicity risk and bone marrow suppression
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; consult prescriber before combining immunosuppressants or chemotherapy agents

avoid_supplements.name: Para-aminobenzoic acid (PABA)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: PABA is a competitive substrate for bacterial folate synthesis; supplemental PABA may reduce antibiotic efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid PABA supplements during TMP-SMX therapy and for 48 hours after discontinuation

avoid_supplements.name: High-dose folic acid (>1mg daily)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May antagonize the antimicrobial activity of trimethoprim by bypassing the blocked folate pathway
avoid_supplements.action: Use only standard prenatal doses (0.4-0.8mg) if medically necessary; inform prescriber of supplementation

caution_supplements.name: Potassium supplements or potassium-sparing agents
caution_supplements.mechanism: Trimethoprim can increase serum potassium levels; concurrent potassium supplementation may elevate risk of hyperkalemia
caution_supplements.action: Monitor potassium levels if supplementation required; ensure adequate renal function

caution_supplements.name: NSAIDs
caution_supplements.mechanism: May increase serum creatinine and reduce renal clearance of TMP-SMX metabolites
caution_supplements.action: Use lowest effective dose and monitor renal function; maintain adequate hydration

avoid_foods.name: High-dose vitamin supplements containing folate antagonists
avoid_foods.mechanism: Excessive micronutrient intake may interfere with antibiotic mechanism or worsen folate depletion
avoid_foods.action: Maintain normal dietary folate intake; avoid megadose supplement regimens during therapy

caution_foods.name: High-potassium foods (bananas, leafy greens, potatoes, orange juice)
caution_foods.mechanism: Trimethoprim may increase serum potassium; excessive dietary potassium may elevate hyperkalemia risk in susceptible patients
caution_foods.action: Monitor potassium intake in patients with renal impairment or on concurrent ACE inhibitors; ensure adequate hydration

caution_foods.name: Dairy products consumed with medication
caution_foods.mechanism: Calcium and magnesium in dairy may slightly reduce absorption of TMP-SMX if taken simultaneously
caution_foods.action: Separate dairy intake by 2+ hours from TMP-SMX administration; take with water

monitoring_notes: Monitor for signs of folate deficiency (megaloblastic anemia, peripheral neuropathy) and hyperkalemia, particularly in renal impairment or elderly patients. Assess baseline CBC, renal function, and potassium levels; recheck during prolonged therapy exceeding 2 weeks.
